unit.why: A single narrative, quoted from the book Hamesh Yadot: a learned heretic comes to R. Levi Yitzhak of Berditchev to debate him and is brought to full repentance.

stories.start_quote: מספרים על איש אחד ממשכילי הדור
stories.end_quote: מבלי לבקש צדדים והיתרים ולקיים ככל התורה
stories.summary_en: A learned heretic who had argued with many great rabbis comes to debate the Berditchever, finds him studying in rapture and repeating 'perhaps it is true', is seized with fear, and through the rebbe's warning about the danger 'if it is true' becomes a complete penitent.
